item.content:encoded: I can't express how much I love this. The whole trilogy, but especially this piece. The characters are incredibly expressive and hook me right in. They feel like real people in a real situation. Loyd's plight and his grappling with iteration made me laugh and dread in turn. Veronica's years of trouble and irreplacable personality kept her near to my heart. This is one of my favourite pieces I've ever read on this site. It's truly fantastic.

item.content:encoded:
This is absolutely terrific. It could use a proofread, although that’s forgivable given the length and time pressure, and I think the length is necessary for the character development it permits.

What I think is most impressive is that in both your tales to date, you’ve adopted the perspective of the other author’s character, and used Veronica as a foil for them. That is a very challenging approach, but it has been executed extremely well - I feel like I’ve learned more about the characters opposite Veronica, but in a way that respects the original author’s conception.

I don’t know what would upset me more at this stage - if Veronica doesn’t make it to the final of the OCT, or if she does and I don’t, so I don’t get to write her.
